title: Does what it's supposed to do.
text: Does what it's supposed to do.. I wanted to say something nice about this machine.  Well .. it's HUGE on the kitchen cabinet!  It IS powerful and would probably emulsify a rock.  Wife and I decided we didn't like what it made.  Juices are probably good for you with everything blasted into a smooth puree.  I can't say the price is too high.  You want to see high?  Go price a Vita Mix!

product_metadata.title: Montel Williams 8 Speed HealthMaster Elite 1200 Watt Blender - Fruit & Vegetable Emulsifier, Juicer & Food Processor with Recipe Book and DVD
